name: Question 15
problem:
Find $Tu$ if 
$T=[\begin{aligned}x & y & x \\ x & -y & x \\ -x & -y & x\end{aligned}]$
and
$u=[\begin{aligned}x \\ 0 \\ -x\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Tu & =[\begin{aligned}x & y & x \\ x & -y & x \\ -x & -y & x\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ 0 \\ -x\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}x\cdot x+y\cdot 0+x\cdot (-x) \\ x\cdot x+(-y)\cdot 0+x\cdot (-x) \\ (-x)\cdot x+(-y)\cdot 0+x\cdot (-x)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+0-{x}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+0-{x}^{2} \\ -{x}^{2}+0-{x}^{2}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ -2{x}^{2}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Question 15
?

Find Tu if T=[xyxx−yx−x−yx] and u=[x0−x].

a
[x3y0−x3y]
b
[x2−x20]
c
[x20−x2]
d
[x2y0−x2y]
e
[00−2x2]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

Tu=[xyxx−yx−x−yx][x0−x]=[x⋅x+y⋅0+x⋅(−x)x⋅x+(−y)⋅0+x⋅(−x)(−x)⋅x+(−y)⋅0+x⋅(−x)]=[x2+0−x2x2+0−x2−x2+0−x2]=[00−2x2]
